badge.originalHint: Keeps the image’s original colors and background; transparent areas show the folder. The image is centered. Images with no transparency fill the folder front; the extra is cropped from the center and the folder rim stays visible.
badge.engravedHint: Turns the image into a single-color engraving. A transparent background is recommended; images with a background are engraved along with it.
badge.importHint: Supports static PNG, SVG and JPG/JPEG images (up to 10 MiB, 4096 px per side and 16 million pixels).
badge.opaque: This image has no transparent background and only supports original colors.

asset.error.unsupported: This badge uses unsupported features. SVG text, images, filters, animation, stylesheets and unknown features are rejected; PNG must be static; JPEG must use RGB or grayscale (CMYK is unsupported).
asset.error.empty: The badge has no visible content.
asset.error.reference: The SVG contains an external, missing, cyclic or incompatible resource reference.
asset.error.complexity: The SVG exceeds the supported complexity budget.
asset.error.timeout: Badge loading timed out and was stopped. Choose a simpler file or restore the last valid badge.
